session.name: MPI-607 TTS: settled the architecture - Chatterbox only, TTS-then-VC, and a ~60+5 voice library

goal.original: Resolve Qwen3-TTS viability, then wire Chatterbox + Qwen as Flows.
goal.summary: Architecture is SETTLED and Qwen is out of the shipped product. Vision ships Chatterbox only; Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign is a bench authoring tool. Runtime is FL_ChatterboxTTS(text, audio_prompt=<performance clip>, cfg_weight=0.3, exaggeration=1.2) -> FL_ChatterboxVC(target_voice=<character clip>), so the library is ~60 neutral character clips plus ~5-8 shared emotional performance clips. Every parameter was measured and heard. No Vision repo code has been written yet.

completed: Step 2b PASSED - a Qwen-designed synthetic voice clones through Chatterbox 'spot-on' (Fabio). The planned HF Space was dead (DashScope proxy, errors for everyone); used the official Qwen/Qwen3-TTS ZeroGPU space instead

Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign RUNS LOCALLY at G:/ComfyUi/_qwen_tts_rt/ - transformers 4.57.3 venv built by virtualenv off the bench's EMBEDDABLE python, torch inherited, 4 packages/~13MB, bench ComfyUI untouched on 5.13.0

DECISION: Qwen NOT shipped. Fabio's reason is architectural - a second Python env in an app that swaps models constantly is fragile, and the runtime is cheap ONLY because it inherits torch, which is the coupling that breaks on an engine bump
ACCENT closed NEGATIVE after 22 generations - strong American prior, not controllable. Library ships with no accent axis
EMOTION works at cfg_weight 0.3; the node default 0.5 suppresses it entirely
Built research/speaker_similarity.py - Chatterbox's own CAMPPlus x-vector encoder as an objective identity gate
VC PIPELINE PASSES at exaggeration 1.2 - carries emotion, keeps identity (0.79-0.87), and sounds MORE natural than direct TTS
pending: Step 3 SHIP CHATTERBOX - unblocked since the start of the day, still not started, and it needs nothing else settled. The highest-value next move.
Author the ~5-8 emotional performance clips - the quality lever. Selection criterion is NOT 'does the clip sound emotional' but 'does TTS driven from it produce strong emotion'.
Library taxonomy - ~60 voices over gender x age x delivery-type, tags not folders, no accent axis. A design conversation (mpi-brainstorm), not started.

Two loose ends, neither blocking: the multilingual clone durations are anomalous (22-30s for ~12 words, suspect repetition_penalty 2.0), and whether a GENUINELY accented reference survives Chatterbox is untested.

task_card.title: TTS in Vision: resolve Qwen3-TTS viability, then wire Chatterbox + Qwen as Flows

next_action.description: Start Step 3 - ship Chatterbox into Vision as a Flow. It has been unblocked all along and depends on none of the library work. Read docs/playbooks/add-flow/ and run /mpi-add-flow. The runtime contract is fixed: FL_ChatterboxTTS(cfg_weight=0.3, exaggeration=1.2) -> FL_ChatterboxVC, ONE coupled intensity control in the UI (never two sliders), and Perth marking on every audio output path (EU AI Act Art. 50, in force since 2026-08-02).

key_decisions: Qwen3-TTS is NOT shipped - it is a BENCH AUTHORING TOOL only. Do not revive shipping it; the objection is architectural fragility, not cost or licence.

Runtime pipeline is TTS-then-VC. Emotion is a property of the PIPELINE, not of the library - which is why a new emotion costs ~1 clip and a user's own uploaded voice inherits the full emotional range for free (it is only ever a VC target_voice).

Accent is a closed NEGATIVE on VoiceDesign after 22 generations across prose, the model's own structured grammar, intensity wording, city anchors and phonetic traits. Do not retry without new information.

DramaBox is being reconsidered by Fabio and is a SEPARATE CARD. It was already rejected here on measured grounds (240 HF dl/30d, stale since 2026-05-23, 24GB VRAM, no weight sharing) - let the new card start informed rather than rediscover that.
constraints: LOCKED PARAMETERS, all measured: cfg_weight 0.3 (node default 0.5 kills emotion outright), VC-source exaggeration 1.2 (1.5 -> identity 0.70, 2.0 -> 0.61), identity gate cosine >= 0.70. exaggeration and cfg_weight are COUPLED - the Flow must expose ONE intensity control, never two sliders, or users reproduce the 'fast and mechanical' artefact.

Three of four 'the model cannot do this' conclusions this session turned out to be MY PARAMETERS, not the model - cfg_weight suppressing emotion, emotion prompt blocks rewriting acoustic identity lines, and VC fed an under-driven performance. Only the accent finding survived scrutiny. Measure against a tuned baseline before concluding a model is weak.

Speaker identity is MEASURABLE - research/speaker_similarity.py loads Chatterbox's CAMPPlus encoder from models/chatterbox/chatterbox/s3gen.safetensors. Use it as the library QA gate instead of auditioning everything by ear.

Identity survives an emotion change ONLY if pitch/speed/volume/clarity/texture are frozen in the prompt and just emotion/tone/personality/style-note vary - and even then it is voice-dependent (ordinary timbre held 0.68-0.88, extreme gravelly bass fell to 0.45-0.61). The SEED barely matters; the prompt determines identity.

The bench runtime at G:/ComfyUi/_qwen_tts_rt/ needs a `.pth` naming the base site-packages - `virtualenv --system-site-packages` SILENTLY fails to inherit off an embeddable python despite pyvenv.cfg saying it did. Same trap would hit any isolated-runtime design for the app.
generate_voice_design(language=...) wants the spelled-out name; 'en' raises.
Bench output lands in D:/WORK/Images/Outputs, NOT <ComfyUI>/output.
